# Lukas Grünzweil

> Lukas Grünzweil is a student at HTL Leonding, a higher technical college in Leonding, Austria. He builds backend systems, AI tooling and games, mainly in C#, Unity and Python. He graduates in June 2027 and is open to a backend internship or thesis project. Contact: lukas.gruenzweil@liwest.at.

This file summarises https://gruenzweil.cc/ for language models. The website and the résumé PDFs are the source of truth; the facts below are kept in sync with them.

## Key facts

- Name: Lukas Grünzweil
- Status: student at HTL Leonding (Höhere Technische Lehranstalt), graduating June 2027
- Based in: Linz area, Upper Austria
- Looking for: a backend internship or thesis project
- Languages spoken: German (native), English (professional working proficiency)

- Tools and infrastructure: Unity, Docker (strongest); Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Azure, Proxmox

## Experience

- SlideLizard Software GmbH, Linz. Software Engineering Intern, August 2026. Built a PWA on top of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales with speech-to-text meeting notes (Azure Speech) and an Azure OpenAI assistant wired into Dataverse, plus a daily GEO-visibility tracker over OpenRouter. Stack: Angular, TypeScript. The head of development called it one of the best projects to come out of an internship there.
- Caritas Upper Austria, Leonding. Office & IT Assistant Intern, July–August 2025. Administration, accounting assistance including quarterly billing, and first-level IT and infrastructure support.

## Projects

- [vektorgrid](https://github.com/vektorgrid-ai): a self-hosted voice assistant built as a distributed system. C++ edge relays catch the wake-word and stream audio to Origin, a C# orchestrator that drives a Python pipeline (speech-to-text, intent router, expert LLM, text-to-speech) in sequence. Nodes never talk to each other directly. Risky tool calls pause for biometric approval in Gate, a Kotlin phone app that also works as a standalone relay. Lukas is the architect and primary developer.
- [SceneForge AI](https://github.com/lGruenzweilHTL/SceneForge-AI): an AI plugin for the Unity Editor. Describe a scene in plain text and get GameObjects and components back. C#, Unity.
- [UniConsole](https://github.com/lGruenzweilHTL/UniConsole): a free, lightweight in-game debug console for Unity. Mark a static method with [Command] and call it from a terminal in the scene. An alternative to Quantum Console. C#, Unity.
- Forkcast (private school project): a meal-planning app with recipe search via the Spoonacular API, a meal calendar, combined ingredient lists, ratings and friends. Lukas wrote most of the TypeScript backend; the frontend is Vue.
- [Space Defenders](https://github.com/lGruenzweilHTL/Space-Defenders): a mobile arcade game in Unity with escalating waves of enemy spaceships, built for touchscreens.
- P.I.G.E.O.N. — Covert Ops (in progress): a satirical Unity game in which you play a pigeon running covert ops for the government.
- [RoboDucks — RescueMaze](https://github.com/lGruenzweilHTL/lego-spike-serial): robotics competition work for the HTL Leonding robotics club. A custom serial protocol between a Raspberry Pi and a LEGO SPIKE hub, and a maze-exploration controller using Trémaux's algorithm in simulation. Python, C.

## Beyond code

- Runs a homelab of three Proxmox nodes hosting Nextcloud, Vaultwarden, Jellyfin, a Minecraft server, Pi-hole and this website.
- 3D prints functional parts and keeps upgrading a heavily modded Ender 3 Pro running Klipper.
- Rides motorbikes (an Aprilia Tuono 125).
